input: Get a structural survey on the chimney breast

gold.taskTitle: Get a structural survey on the chimney breast
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete a professional structural survey specifically focused on the chimney breast of a property.

questions.title: Is this for a home you own or are buying?
questions.description: Understand whether this is a pre-purchase survey, a survey on an existing home, or related to a sale.

questions.title: What specific concern prompted the survey request?
questions.description: Identify the trigger, such as visible cracks, a recent removal, damp, or a routine check.

questions.title: Has the chimney breast been altered or partially removed?
questions.description: Determine if any structural work has previously been done to the chimney breast that the surveyor needs to know about.

questions.title: Do you need a full structural engineer's report or a basic survey?
questions.description: Clarify the level of detail required, as a chartered structural engineer's report differs from a general surveyor's inspection.

questions.title: What is the rough age and construction type of the property?
questions.description: Establish whether the building is Victorian, Edwardian, modern, etc., and the wall construction, as this affects the survey approach.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline for when the report is needed?
questions.description: Determine any time pressure, such as a property exchange date or a contractor start date.

questions.title: What is the approximate location of the property?
questions.description: Identify the region or city so that locally available structural surveyors or engineers can be sourced.
